title: United-Guardian Declares Cash Dividend
summary: Dividend payments enter their 31st straight year as United-Guardian sets a $0.25 per-share payout for Feb. 17 to holders of record on Feb. 9.
body_markdown:
On the day this news was published, **UG** gained **9.04%** , reflecting a notable positive market reaction. Argus tracked a peak move of **+4.2%** during that session. Our momentum scanner triggered **5 alerts** that day, indicating moderate trading interest and price volatility. This price movement added approximately **$3M** to the company's valuation, bringing the market cap to **$33.31M** at that time. Trading volume was very high at **3.6x** the daily average, suggesting strong buying interest.
